items.title: Italian taxpayers are paying millions to keep Russian yachts afloat
items.brief: An expensive floating eyesore has marred views in the port of Trieste, northern Italy, for more than four years, and it is costing Italian taxpayers millions to maintain, the city’s mayor says.

items.title: Golden State Valkyries make history with first WNBA title in the team’s second year of existence
items.brief: The Golden State Valkyries made history on Saturday, clinching the franchise’s first WNBA championship with a 68-63 Game 7 win over the Atlanta Dream.

items.title: Judge tosses Trump’s lawsuit against Wall Street Journal again, this time for good
items.brief: A federal judge on Saturday again dismissed President Donald Trump’s defamation lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal over its reporting on a lewd birthday letter to Jeffrey Epstein bearing Trump’s name.

items.title: Protests spread to Germany as hundreds of thousands march again in France
items.brief: Cost-of-living protests that began in France have spread to Germany where demonstrations to coincide with Halloween took place on Saturday, with tens of thousands of people turning out across the country.

items.brief: Dmytro had not seen his wife Larisa for 1,711 days.

items.title: Pregnant woman killed, 6 others wounded in targeted shooting at California Spirit Halloween store, police say
items.brief: One person was killed and six others injured after a shooting inside a shopping mall at a Spirit Halloween store in Fairfield, California, on Friday night, police said.
